Overview

The hidden cost of Applied AI & GenAI for Public Sector & Government is never the model; it is the scaffolding — data contracts, evaluation harnesses, rollback machinery, audit evidence. We price and build that scaffolding explicitly, on case & benefits platforms, because that is where programs actually succeed or die. For Public Sector & Government, the design tension is specific — service standards on one side, GDPR / privacy regimes on the other, and a control environment that must survive both internal audit and external inspection. We build for that tension explicitly rather than discovering it at gate review.
